page1: The Champi Warrior is a mobile infantry unit built for scouting, raiding, and putting pressure on exposed enemies. Its protection against arrows helps it close with foot archers, while its attacks threaten siege weapons and buildings. It can also build Outposts to watch important ground.

Four civilizations bring different strengths to this unit: cheaper recruitment, greater endurance, faster movement, or faster attacks. We will compare their fully upgraded Champi Warriors against the same opponents, balancing army sizes by resource cost and population efficiency.
page2Narration: The Inca Champi Warriors generally perform best against ranged opponents.
Mapuche Champi Warriors stand out in melee engagements, delivering the strongest overall results up close.
Muisca Champi Warriors shine against low-attack melee units, where their extra armor makes each hit less effective.
Tupi Champi Warriors struggle overall, but their faster attacks shine against monks, earning the best result in the Missionary matchup.
